visual_identity.core_identity: A stationary cave fungus whose thick stalk and broad cap contain a mouthlike gill opening that produces an alarm shriek.
visual_identity.silhouette: Large mushroom silhouette with stout stalk, broad cap, and an opened underside gill cavity.
visual_identity.head_features: No animal head; the underside of the cap opens like a simple mouth or resonant gill chamber.
visual_identity.body_shape: Single rooted mushroom body with thick stalk and cap, no arms or legs.
visual_identity.surface: Smooth cap with sparse spots or folds, simple gill lines underneath.

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
